confidence_notes: City averages informed meals, coffee and draft beer. Cocktail and wine estimates use local menu prices and their premium over draft beer. July lodging is modeled, with private hostel rooms especially uncertain. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Merida), [Yucatán Today](https://yucatantoday.com/blog/tour-bares-y-cantinas-merida-guia-parte-3), [Taco House menu](https://www.tacohouse.mx/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/TacoHouseMerida-Menu-v20260116.pdf).
comparable_city_reasoning: Campeche provides a regional comparison for independent lodging in a historic Yucatán Peninsula city. The estimates account for Mérida’s larger visitor market and hot, rainy July.
